query_template: Run an expert calls analysis for {{company}}: surface the most relevant Guidepoint expert-call interviews on the target and its comps over the lookback window {{lookback_window}}, extract quote-backed themes, separate corroborated signal from single-source anecdote, track expert tone across quarters, and map findings to the target's KPIs and live investor debates — every claim tied to a dated interview. Peer set override: {{peers}}. Focus themes: {{focus_themes}}. Data sources: {{data_source}}. Output format: {{output_format}}. Additional context: {{additional_context}}.

pages.title: Whose expert calls do you want analyzed?
pages.description: Synthesize what customers, competitors, channel partners, and former employees are saying — quote-backed and dated

fields.label: Comp set override
fields.placeholder: e.g., PANW, ZS, S — leave blank to derive from the peer tool and the 10-K competitor set
fields.description: Leave blank to have the comp set built automatically with rationale for each peer.

fields.label: Focus themes
fields.description: Leave empty to let the evidence rank the themes.

fields.label: Data sources
fields.description: Select every data provider you want this run to draw on. Guidepoint is the expert-call engine of this skill; providers you have not connected are skipped gracefully and noted, so connecting them enriches the output. Perplexity Finance is always available.

fields.label: Additional context
fields.placeholder: e.g., we are testing whether the NRR stabilization debate is resolvable; weight customer and channel interviews.
